salary_details.details: The notification does not specify whether this amount is monthly or annual. | The tenure is 01 (One) year, extendable up to 03 years, subject to satisfactory performance, willingness, conduct of the candidate and requirements of the institution. The contract will be terminated in case of appointment/joining of a bonded Senior Resident on the same post. The competent authority can terminate services at any time in the public interest without prior notice or reason. To resign, the Senior Resident must submit one-month advance notice or deposit an amount equivalent to one month's salary. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of both the one-month salary and the security deposit, and may lead to legal proceedings. The Senior Resident cannot claim service benefits including Provident Fund (PF), Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, Promotion or similar perks. Hostel accommodation/quarters will be provided to the extent possible but cannot be claimed as a right. If accommodation is availed, no HRA is payable, and the licence fee and any other sum in lieu of HRA will be deducted as per rule. Instructions, circulars and policies issued by ESIC Headquarters Office, New Delhi from time to time are applicable and binding. Absence from work exceeding 07 (seven) days without prior approval is treated as voluntary abandonment, resulting in automatic termination. Attendance must be recorded both manually and through the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily on scheduled working days. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as Senior Resident at ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad. Other terms and conditions apply as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time. | The selected candidate must submit the security deposit through a Demand Draft payable to "ESI Fund A/c No. 1" at Faridabad upon joining. It will be refunded on successful completion of the contract period and submission of a "No Dues Certificate". If the selected candidate resigns within six months of joining, the deposit will be forfeited, except in unforeseen or unavoidable circumstances where relaxation may be considered.

selection_process: Candidates appear before the Document Verification Committee on the interview date with their offline application form and self-attested copies of documents. Only candidates whose documents are successfully verified are allowed before the Interview Board. Selection is made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance in the interview

conducted by a duly constituted selection board. The result will be published only in the Recruitments section of the website www.esic.gov.in. The offer of appointment will be sent through E-mail only. Selected candidates must join as per the instructions in the offer of appointment.
how_to_apply: The notification does not mention any online application. It requires a mandatory offline application form (attached with the advertisement), so there is no "apply online" link. The application form itself is not reproduced in the provided document.
Download and complete the offline application form attached with the official advertisement.
Prepare the Demand Draft for the application fee, if your category is required to pay.
Collect self-attested copies of the required documents along with the originals, and the provided checklist.
Report to the Examination Hall, Academic Block, ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad on 09.10.2026 between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.
Complete document verification, then appear before the Interview Board if your documents are verified.

Candidates may apply for multiple posts listed in the advertisement if they meet the eligibility criteria for each. A separate application, with required documents and applicable fees, must be submitted for each post.
Certificate of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth
All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MBBS
All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/Other Examination

Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD Certificate issued in the format for appointment in Central Govt. job, wherever applicable. Without it the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the reserved category but can be treated as a UR candidate.
State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated)
Experience Certificate
Recent passport size photograph of candidate
Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current employer, if applicable
Aadhaar Card
Documents (i) to (ix) are verified against originals. If any applicable document is not verified by the Document Verification Committee, the candidate will not be allowed in the interview.
The EWS certificate should be as per Annexure-I of DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt(Res), dated 31.01.2019.

The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate should be issued not prior to one year from the cut-off date, in the format applicable for appointment under the Government of India, by an officer not below the rank of Sub-Divisional Officer or equivalent authority of the concerned State for Central Govt. job.
Applications must be submitted for each post separately and in the prescribed format only. Applications in any other format, or incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.
Wrong declarations, false information or any action contrary to law will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
Mere submission of an application does not confer any right to be eligible for interview unless the candidate reports on the scheduled date and time with the required documents.
The interview opportunity is provisional, subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility criteria.
The Dean, ESIC MCH, FBD reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment process at any stage without notice.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or submitting any document.
Applicants must visit www.esic.gov.in regularly, as any Corrigendum/Addendum/Updates will be uploaded only to the website.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists vacancies for Senior Resident across three departments, category-wise. Adding these figures gives 16 posts in ICU, 15 in NICU and 12 in PICU, or 43 in all. The grand total is calculated from the table and is not printed separately in the notification. In the ICU department, if candidates with a postgraduate qualification do not appear, MBBS doctors without a PG degree may be considered for appointment for 01 year as Non-PG Resident against a Senior Resident post on contract basis. They need 02 years of experience, of which one year must be in the concerned speciality (ICU/General Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Casualty/Anesthesia) from a government or private hospital (not a private clinic).

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is determined as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notification also states that eligibility will be determined as per ESIC Headquarters Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022, or any subsequent orders issued by the Headquarters Office. Age: not exceeding 45 years on the date of walk-in interview. Educational qualification: in accordance with the latest NMC/MCI guidelines. Medical registration: candidates must hold updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council) with all post-MBBS/MD/MS qualification(s). Candidates working in a Government/Autonomous/Statutory Institution should preferably have a "NOC" from their employer at the time of interview. The notification says the educational qualifications are "in accordance with the latest guidelines of the National Medical Commission (NMC/MCI)". It does not list specific degree names or speciality-wise requirements for Senior Resident. The required documents list refers to MBBS and MD/MS/DNB/other examination certificates, and the Non-PG Resident option applies to MBBS doctors as described above. Candidates should check the original notification before attending. The age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of the walk-in interview (09.10.2026). The notification does not mention age relaxation. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. If a candidate does not have updated registration from the Medical Council, they must show and submit a copy of the "Applied for document(s)" to the concerned authority at the time of interview. If these two clauses are not fulfilled, the candidate may not be interviewed, or the result will be withheld if the expert committee allows them to appear. A selected candidate must submit an updated Medical Registration Certificate before joining. If a NOC is not immediately available, a copy of the "applied for NOC" and an undertaking must be submitted at the time of Document Verification before the interview is allowed.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident Salary
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify whether this amount is monthly or annual. The tenure is 01 (One) year, extendable up to 03 years, subject to satisfactory performance, willingness, conduct of the candidate and requirements of the institution. The contract will be terminated in case of appointment/joining of a bonded Senior Resident on the same post. The competent authority can terminate services at any time in the public interest without prior notice or reason. To resign, the Senior Resident must submit one-month advance notice or deposit an amount equivalent to one month's salary. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of both the one-month salary and the security deposit, and may lead to legal proceedings. The Senior Resident cannot claim service benefits including Provident Fund (PF), Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, Promotion or similar perks. Hostel accommodation/quarters will be provided to the extent possible but cannot be claimed as a right. If accommodation is availed, no HRA is payable, and the licence fee and any other sum in lieu of HRA will be deducted as per rule. Instructions, circulars and policies issued by ESIC Headquarters Office, New Delhi from time to time are applicable and binding. Absence from work exceeding 07 (seven) days without prior approval is treated as voluntary abandonment, resulting in automatic termination. Attendance must be recorded both manually and through the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily on scheduled working days. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as Senior Resident at ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad. Other terms and conditions apply as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time. The selected candidate must submit the security deposit through a Demand Draft payable to "ESI Fund A/c No. 1" at Faridabad upon joining. It will be refunded on successful completion of the contract period and submission of a "No Dues Certificate". If the selected candidate resigns within six months of joining, the deposit will be forfeited, except in unforeseen or unavoidable circumstances where relaxation may be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Employees State Insurance Corporation Medical College & Hospital Faridabad (ESIC Faridabad) in Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts offered are Senior Resident across specialized departments including ICU, NICU, and PICU on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 77 vacancies distributed among Senior Resident positions in ICU, NICU, and PICU departments as per the official distribution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit any online application prior to the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for ESIC Faridabad positions?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the announced vacancies is scheduled to take place on 9 October 2026 at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required for Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate qualification like MD, MS, or DNB in the concerned specialty, or an MBBS degree with 2 years of experience for non-PG residents in ICU.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at not exceeding 45 years as on the date specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary provided for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Resident position will receive a consolidated monthly pay amounting to Rs. 1,50,294/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: SC, ST, ESIC regular employees, female candidates, and PH candidates are exempt with Nil fee, while all other categories must pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this ESIC Faridabad recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises two main stages: Document Verification followed by a personal Interview conducted directly at the venue.
